parameters.jsCode: const p=JSON.parse(Buffer.from($('Validate Slack Client').item.json.payload_base64,'base64').toString('utf8')); const names=p.primary_contact_name.trim().split(/\s+/); const firstname=names.shift()||p.primary_contact_name,lastname=names.join(' '); const contact_body=JSON.stringify({inputs:[{id:p.primary_contact_email,idProperty:'email',properties:{email:p.primary_contact_email,firstname,lastname}}]}); const company_search_body=JSON.stringify({filterGroups:[{filters:[{propertyName:'name',operator:'EQ',value:p.company_name}]}],properties:['name'],limit:1}); return [{json:{...p,firstname,lastname,amount:String((p.value_cents/100).toFixed(2)),contact_body,company_search_body}}];

const found=$json.results?.[0]; const source=$('Prepare HubSpot Sync').item.json; return [{json:{...source,company_id:found?.id?String(found.id):'',create_company:!found?.id,company_body:JSON.stringify({properties:{name:source.company_name}})}}];

const source=$('Prepare HubSpot Sync').item.json; const contact=$('Upsert HubSpot Contact').item.json.results?.[0]; const companyId=$json.id??$json.company_id; if(!contact?.id||!companyId) throw new Error('HubSpot contact/company ID missing'); const deal_body=JSON.stringify({properties:{dealname:source.deal_name,pipeline:'default',dealstage:'closedwon',amount:source.amount,closedate:source.closed_won_at},associations:[{to:{id:String(contact.id)},types:[{associationCategory:'HUBSPOT_DEFINED',associationTypeId:3}]},{to:{id:String(companyId)},types:[{associationCategory:'HUBSPOT_DEFINED',associationTypeId:5}]}]}); return [{json:{...source,contact_id:String(contact.id),company_id:String(companyId),deal_body}}];

const result=$('Create Onboarding Atomically').item.json.result??{}; const onboardingId=String(result.onboarding_id??result.id??''); if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(onboardingId))throw new Error('Created onboarding ID is unavailable'); return [{json:{onboarding_id:onboardingId,request_body:JSON.stringify({onboarding_id:onboardingId})}}];
